card.name: Digits inside numbers in data tables
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle or end of a multi-digit number inside a table of values, such as organ radiation doses or dose-by-kidney-function charts.

modes.label: Radiation dose tables
modes.description: Digits of decimal values in absorbed-dose tables listed by organ, often next to Adrenals.

modes.label: Dose lookup charts
modes.description: Digits of numbers in dose charts by creatinine clearance or age.

card.writes: Promotes unrelated Chinese words and suppresses words about precision, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on a digit inside a number in a table of doses or measurements.
